task_description: Write a method in Dafny to perform the mathematical bitwise xor operation across the given two sequences of Bit-vector.
specification_response:
method BitwiseXorSequences(seq1: seq<Bitvector>, seq2: seq<Bitvector>) returns (result: seq<Bitvector>)
Postconditions_prompt:
- The length of the result sequence should be equal to the length of the input sequences
- For each index i in the result sequence, result[i] should be the bitwise XOR of seq1[i] and seq2[i]
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method BitwiseXorSeqs(seq1: seq<bit>, seq2: seq<bit>) returns (result: seq<bit>)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - Both sequences should be non-null
    - Both sequences should have the same length
    
Dafny specification:
    requires seq1 != null
    requires seq2 != null
    requires |seq1| == |seq2|
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The result sequence should have the same length as the input sequences
    - Each element in the result sequence should be the bitwise xor of the corresponding elements in the input sequences
    
Dafny specification:
    ensures result != null
    ensures |result| == |seq1|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == seq1[i] ^ seq2[i]
  
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method BitwiseXorSeqs(seq1: seq<bit>, seq2: seq<bit>) returns (result: seq<bit>)
    requires seq1 != null
    requires seq2 != null
    requires |seq1| == |seq2|
    ensures result != null
    ensures |result| == |seq1|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == seq1[i] ^ seq2[i]
{
    result := new seq<bit>(|seq1|);
    var i := 0;
    while i < |seq1|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |seq1|
        invariant |result| == |seq1|
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> result[k] == seq1[k] ^ seq2[k]
    {
        result[i] := seq1[i] ^ seq2[i];
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
